text: Gating my own (old) data on my own device behind a pay wall? That sounds borderline ransomware!
author: Bence
developer_reply:
Core unlimited habit tracking features are free forever.
Backing data up to drive, which allows you to restore on new devices, and accessing old journals is paid. These are custom features and the motivation helps me to keep on improving the app. Please mail to contact@habityou.com for any queriess.
